facts.fact: Public registration for the new biometric national ID card opened on 4 August 2026 in Greater Banjul under the National Identity Management System launched 30 June 2026, with phased expansion to other regions from 7 September 2026.
The government says the system combines a national identity register with biometric technology to reduce duplicate identities and fraud.
